comment: Getting aggressive with a brotherly coin flip to start Segment 3, but I think Alex is just playing really good golf right now.

Leaning on a consistent 2026 track record for my captain’s pick at a course that’s relatively unknown.
I am so close to declaring Clark fully back to the leaderboard threat he was back when he was winning majors and shooting 60s at Pebble Beach. The putter and moxy was inspiring at Muirfield Village.
Riding the hot hand who has also had plenty of success up north. Perfect time to use him.
